question: After inspectable two-version runtime proof is attached, should Bobby approve advertising EmDash 0.32.0 in this package's tested peer contract?
rationale: AGENTS.md explicitly reserves merge approval to Bobby, and this PR changes the public pre-1.0 compatibility promise.

options.title: Approve after matrix proof
options.body: Approve the contract only after redacted evidence demonstrates the documented 0.29.0 and 0.32.0 runtime scenarios.

options.title: Keep the existing contract
options.body: Decline the widening and retain the 0.29.0-only peer contract until a repeatable compatibility lane is available.

recommendation.title: Approve after matrix proof
recommendation.body: Approve the contract only after redacted evidence demonstrates the documented 0.29.0 and 0.32.0 runtime scenarios.
